<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="sack-states" name="Sack State Machine and Lifecycle"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="3380" pageHeight="1420" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="hdr_bg" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#102a43;strokeColor=none;arcSize=4;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="3300" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hdr_title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=24;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#ffffff;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="SACK STATE MACHINE AND TRANSITION LIFECYCLE" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="2200" x="65" y="28" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hdr_sub" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=14;fontColor=#bcccdc;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="The seven sack states across farm, trip, collection center, and port: events, responsible roles, guards, and offline reconciliation rules." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="2200" x="65" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hdr_meta" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#9fb3c8;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="Refs aroma-pacifico/aroma-pacifico-roadmap#19 | Closes ALPH-29 | Source: docs/sack-and-trip.md sec 3-4, docs/security-and-identity.md sec 8 | Box badges: D04, D05, D06" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="2200" x="65" y="84" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hdr_badge" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d97706;strokeColor=#ffffff;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="RECOVERY TARGETS (ASM-157, PD-153)
RPO: 15 min for sack events | RTO: 4 h for public lookup
7 States (Part C) -> 4 Design System Badges (PD-154)
Offline Rule: Receiver Authoritative (ASM-152)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="78" width="580" x="2740" y="28" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_farm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#16a34a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#166534;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="ZONE 1: FARM ORIGIN & REGISTRATION
Wet Mill Packaging & Producer App Registration" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="730" width="620" x="40" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_trip1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="ZONE 2: IN TRANSIT TO CENTER
Transporter Feeder Road Trip (ASM-159)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="730" width="560" x="680" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_center" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fefce8;strokeColor=#ca8a04;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#854d0e;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="ZONE 3: COLLECTION CENTER (RECEPTION & LOT STAGING) [Box D05]
Cauca, Huila & Tolima Receiving Centers (ASM-151)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="730" width="800" x="1270" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_port" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fdf2f8;strokeColor=#db2777;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#9d174d;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="ZONE 4: IN TRANSIT TO PORT & BUENAVENTURA DELIVERY
Highway Transit & Maritime Port Export Handover" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="730" width="1240" x="2100" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="start_registered" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#22c55e;strokeColor=#15803d;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Pre-printed
Label Batch
Issued" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="95" x="65" y="335" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s1_in_prep" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="in_preparation
Part C: en preparación | Badge: [en preparación]
--------------------------------------------------
• Sack born at wet mill in 60 kg reference (ASM-150)
• Scale weight measured and recorded with 1 decimal
• Confirms drying lot (links to drying variables, ASM-096)
• Code bound from pre-printed batch (80 bits, ASM-094)
• Encrypted outbox buffers until cellular uplink (ASM-079)
• Responsible: Farmer (Farmer App, field pool, no MFA)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="215" width="390" x="235" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s2_transit_center" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="in_transit_to_center
Part C: en viaje al acopio | Badge: [en viaje]
--------------------------------------------------
• Physical custody on vehicle with transporter
• Open trip of type farm_to_center (ASM-159)
• GNSS fix recorded every 5 min en route (PD-110)
• Buffered offline during feeder road dead zones
• Reconnect: custody first, positions oldest first
• Responsible: Transporter (Transporter App, field pool)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="215" width="390" x="790" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3_center_accepted" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ecfdf5;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="at_center_accepted
Part C: en acopio (aceptado) | Badge: [aceptado]
--------------------------------------------------
• Physical reception at collection center (ASM-151)
• Non-terminal: staged for outbound port transport
• Ready for assigned_to_trip to Buenaventura
• Receiver-authoritative: applied if pickup delayed (ASM-152)
• Responsible: Center Operator (Logistics App, TOTP MFA)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="480" x="1530" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s4_center_rejected" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="at_center_rejected
Part C: en acopio (rechazado) | Badge: [rechazado]
--------------------------------------------------
• Physical reception rejected; reason is mandatory
• TERMINAL IN PILOT (ASM-151): does NOT travel to port
• Reprocessed coffee presented as NEW sack with NEW code
• Rejected sack preserves complete historical audit trail
• Responsible: Center Operator (Logistics App, TOTP MFA)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="480" x="1530" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="start_unlabeled" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d97706;strokeColor=#b45309;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Unlabeled Arrival
Center Reserve
(>= 400 codes)
ASM-153" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="115" x="1360" y="735" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s5_transit_port" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="in_transit_to_port
Part C: en viaje al puerto | Badge: [en viaje]
--------------------------------------------------
• Open trip of type center_to_port (ASM-159)
• Origin: collection center; Destination: Buenaventura port
• Center operator assigned accepted sacks (assigned_to_trip)
• GNSS fix recorded every 5 min en route (PD-110)
• Responsible: Transporter (Transporter App, field pool)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="215" width="410" x="2260" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s6_port_accepted" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ecfdf5;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="delivered_at_port_accepted
Part C: entregado en puerto (aceptado)
Badge: [aceptado]
--------------------------------------------------
• TERMINAL STATE
• Handover accepted by port maritime receiver
• Port receiver reference recorded (ASM-057, ASM-077)
• Custody transfer to maritime export complete
• Responsible: Transporter (Transporter App)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="420" x="2900" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s7_port_rejected" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="delivered_at_port_rejected
Part C: entregado en puerto (rechazado)
Badge: [rechazado]
--------------------------------------------------
• TERMINAL STATE
• Handover rejected by port maritime receiver
• Rejection reason & receiver reference recorded
• Commercial dispute audit trace preserved
• Responsible: Transporter (Transporter App)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="420" x="2900" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t1" edge="1" parent="1" source="start_registered" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#16a34a;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="s1_in_prep" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#bbf7d0;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#166534;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T1: sack_registered

[Center Operator (MFA) | recorded_at]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="270" x="1210" y="245" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t4" edge="1" parent="1" source="s2_transit_center" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.75;entryX=0;entryY=0.52;" target="s4_center_rejected" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1180" y="435" /> <mxPoint x="1330" y="435" /> <mxPoint x="1330" y="600" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#fecaca;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T4: received_at_center [rejected, reason]
[Center Operator (MFA) | recorded_at]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="280" x="1210" y="535" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t3b" edge="1" parent="1" source="s1_in_prep" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#0d9488;strokeWidth=2;strokeDashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="s3_center_accepted" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="430" y="275" /> <mxPoint x="430" y="205" /> <mxPoint x="1770" y="205" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t3b" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#99f6e4;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#0f766e;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T3b: Offline Delayed Pickup Rule (ASM-152) — Receiver Authoritative: center reception applied even if pickup still buffered" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="960" x="540" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t5_acc" edge="1" parent="1" source="start_unlabeled" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;exitX=0.2;exitY=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.76;" target="s3_center_accepted" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1383" y="735" /> <mxPoint x="1383" y="380" /> <mxPoint x="1530" y="380" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t5_acc" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#fde68a;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#92400e;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T5: bound_at_center [accepted]
[Center Operator (MFA) | Reserve >= 400 codes (ASM-153)]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="305" x="1210" y="345" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t5_rej" edge="1" parent="1" source="start_unlabeled" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.25;entryY=1;" target="s4_center_rejected" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1475" y="780" /> <mxPoint x="1650" y="780" /> <mxPoint x="1650" y="700" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t5_rej" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#fde68a;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#92400e;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T5: bound_at_center [rejected, reason]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="260" x="1510" y="755" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t6" edge="1" parent="1" source="s3_center_accepted" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.48;entryX=0;entryY=0.3;" target="s5_transit_port" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="2010" y="320" /> <mxPoint x="2135" y="320" /> <mxPoint x="2135" y="340" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#bfdbfe;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T6: departed_to_port (custody)
[Transporter | assigned_to_trip]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="215" x="2025" y="345" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t7" edge="1" parent="1" source="s5_transit_port" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.25;entryX=0;entryY=0.35;" target="s6_port_accepted" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="2670" y="330" /> <mxPoint x="2785" y="330" /> <mxPoint x="2785" y="290" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#a7f3d0;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#065f46;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T7: delivered_at_port [accepted]
[Transporter | receiver_reference]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="230" x="2680" y="245" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t8" edge="1" parent="1" source="s5_transit_port" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.75;entryX=0;entryY=0.52;" target="s7_port_rejected" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="2670" y="435" /> <mxPoint x="2785" y="435" /> <mxPoint x="2785" y="600" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_t8" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#fecaca;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=12.5;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;" value="T8: delivered_at_port [rejected, reason]
[Transporter | receiver_reference]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="230" x="2680" y="535" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_events" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="FIVE NON-STATE-CHANGING EVENTS (DOCS SEC 3.2)

These events record operational milestones and corrections with date, time, and responsible,
but do not alter the lifecycle state of the sack:

1. arrived_at_center:
 Transporter arrives at collection center yard and initiates physical handover.
 Records recorded_at on transporter phone and links open trip to center gate arrival (A10 sec 7).

2. assigned_to_trip:
 Collection-center operator stages accepted sacks onto an outbound center_to_port trip.
 Required guard condition before departed_to_port can be executed by transporter.

3. code_replaced:
 A damaged or illegible physical label is replaced with a fresh code from the center reserve.
 The retired code is marked void in sack_codes and permanently returns 'not found' at lookup.

4. weight_corrected:
 Compensating event correcting scale typographical error. Must be recorded by the same role
 and scope that entered original, citing mandatory reason (ASM-151). Retains full audit history.

5. outcome_corrected:
 Compensating event correcting reception outcome error (e.g. misclassified rejection).
 Same role, scope, and reason rule applies (ASM-151).

Append-Only Immutability Contract:
Zero events are edited or deleted. Every physical act is persisted immutably in sack_event_log.
State is derived by replaying history." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="1040" x="40" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_rules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="OFFLINE ORDERING & TIMESTAMP RECONCILIATION (ASM-152, SEC 3.3, SEC 4)

Every mobile and field actor operates offline on mountain roads. Events reach AWS out of sequence.
Four deterministic rules govern state resolution:

Rule 1: Refuse Only What Caller Cannot Do
 API rejects requests only for invalid credentials/role, unknown/void code, or schema invalidity.
 Once an event represents a physical act that already occurred, it is unconditionally persisted.

Rule 2: Order by Time of the Act (Deterministic Fold)
 Current sack state is recomputed from scratch by replaying the complete event log ordered strictly
 by recorded_at ASC, then event_id ASC. Result is mathematically invariant to network arrival order!

Rule 3: Physical Receiver is Authoritative
 A custody transition recorded by the physical holder (T3, T4, T7, T8) is applied immediately even if
 upstream departure or pickup is still queued in a disconnected phone buffer. Missing steps flagged.

Rule 4: Pre-Registration Events Wait in Pending State
 An event arriving for an issued code prior to its sack_registered upload is held in pending status
 and applied automatically when the registration drains from the farmer's outbox.

Timestamp Rules (Sec 4):
• recorded_at: Device UTC timestamp to millisecond taken at moment of physical act.
 Formatted in America/Bogota (UTC-5) for display (ASM-007).
• received_at: Server UTC timestamp applied by API upon durable persistence in DynamoDB.
• Clock Skew Check: If recorded_at > received_at + 5 min, flagged as phone clock ahead (PD-151)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="1080" x="1110" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_stores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;" value="DATA SCHEMA & STORE ARCHITECTURE (DOCS SEC 4, SEC 10) [KMS KEYS: BOX D06 | VPC TIERS: BOX D04]

Mandatory Event Record Schema (Sec 4):
• event_id: UUID idempotency key generated on device (A10 sec 2)
• event_type: Transition event or non-state-changing event type
• sack_codes: List of Crockford Base32 sack codes covered in batch act
• trip_id: Trip reference (empty for sack_registered)
• recorded_at / received_at: Device act timestamp / API persistence time
• responsible_subject_id / role: Opaque pseudonym & Cognito role (ASM-091)
• device_id / center_id: App installation UUID & collection center ID
• latitude / longitude: GNSS fix coordinates for transporter custody acts
• weight_kg / drying_lot_id: Measured weight & drying lot identifier
• outcome / reason / receiver_reference: Status, rationale, port receipt ref

DynamoDB Stores (Application Tables; KMS Keys Covered by Box D06):
• sack_event_log: PK event_id | Immutable event log | KMS 'records' [Box D06] | Streams enabled
• sacks: PK sack_id | GSI sack_code, farm_id | Current state, version, flags | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• sack_history: PK sack_id, SK recorded_at#event_id | Deterministic fold source | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• trips: PK trip_id | Transporter custody legs & vehicles | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• transport_positions: PK trip_id, SK sequence_no | 5-min GNSS fixes | KMS 'telemetry' [Box D06] (PD-110)
• buyer_view: PK sack_code | Projected public view | KMS 'public_view' [Box D06] (ASM-154)

Disaster Recovery Objectives (Sec 9, ASM-157, PD-153):
• RPO = 15 min: sack-exporter streams JSON Lines to S3 export prefix (ADR-001) every 60 s;
 CloudWatch alarm fires if iterator age > 5 min.
• RTO = 4 h: Public lookup runs serverless via CloudFront + Lambda URL + buyer_view;
 completely decoupled from application API!" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="1120" x="2220" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
in_preparation
Part C: en preparación | Badge: [en preparación]
--------------------------------------------------
• Sack born at wet mill in 60 kg reference (ASM-150)
• Scale weight measured and recorded with 1 decimal
• Confirms drying lot (links to drying variables, ASM-096)
• Code bound from pre-printed batch (80 bits, ASM-094)
• Encrypted outbox buffers until cellular uplink (ASM-079)
• Responsible: Farmer (Farmer App, field pool, no MFA)

in_transit_to_center
Part C: en viaje al acopio | Badge: [en viaje]

div.div:
FIVE NON-STATE-CHANGING EVENTS (DOCS SEC 3.2)
These events record operational milestones and corrections with date, time, and responsible,
but do not alter the lifecycle state of the sack:
1. arrived_at_center:
Transporter arrives at collection center yard and initiates physical handover.
Records recorded_at on transporter phone and links open trip to center gate arrival (A10 sec 7).
2. assigned_to_trip:
Collection-center operator stages accepted sacks onto an outbound center_to_port trip.
Required guard condition before departed_to_port can be executed by transporter.
3. code_replaced:
A damaged or illegible physical label is replaced with a fresh code from the center reserve.
The retired code is marked void in sack_codes and permanently returns 'not found' at lookup.
4. weight_corrected:
Compensating event correcting scale typographical error. Must be recorded by the same role
and scope that entered original, citing mandatory reason (ASM-151). Retains full audit history.
5. outcome_corrected:
Compensating event correcting reception outcome error (e.g. misclassified rejection).
Same role, scope, and reason rule applies (ASM-151).
Append-Only Immutability Contract:
Zero events are edited or deleted. Every physical act is persisted immutably in sack_event_log.
State is derived by replaying history.

div.div:
OFFLINE ORDERING & TIMESTAMP RECONCILIATION (ASM-152, SEC 3.3, SEC 4)
Every mobile and field actor operates offline on mountain roads. Events reach AWS out of sequence.
Four deterministic rules govern state resolution:
Rule 1: Refuse Only What Caller Cannot Do
API rejects requests only for invalid credentials/role, unknown/void code, or schema invalidity.
Once an event represents a physical act that already occurred, it is unconditionally persisted.
Rule 2: Order by Time of the Act (Deterministic Fold)
Current sack state is recomputed from scratch by replaying the complete event log ordered strictly
by recorded_at ASC, then event_id ASC. Result is mathematically invariant to network arrival order!
Rule 3: Physical Receiver is Authoritative
A custody transition recorded by the physical holder (T3, T4, T7, T8) is applied immediately even if
upstream departure or pickup is still queued in a disconnected phone buffer. Missing steps flagged.
Rule 4: Pre-Registration Events Wait in Pending State
An event arriving for an issued code prior to its sack_registered upload is held in pending status
and applied automatically when the registration drains from the farmer's outbox.
Timestamp Rules (Sec 4):
• recorded_at: Device UTC timestamp to millisecond taken at moment of physical act.
Formatted in America/Bogota (UTC-5) for display (ASM-007).
• received_at: Server UTC timestamp applied by API upon durable persistence in DynamoDB.
• Clock Skew Check: If recorded_at > received_at + 5 min, flagged as phone clock ahead (PD-151).

div.div:
DATA SCHEMA & STORE ARCHITECTURE (DOCS SEC 4, SEC 10) [KMS KEYS: BOX D06 | VPC TIERS: BOX D04]
Mandatory Event Record Schema (Sec 4):
• event_id: UUID idempotency key generated on device (A10 sec 2)
• event_type: Transition event or non-state-changing event type
• sack_codes: List of Crockford Base32 sack codes covered in batch act
• trip_id: Trip reference (empty for sack_registered)
• recorded_at / received_at: Device act timestamp / API persistence time
• responsible_subject_id / role: Opaque pseudonym & Cognito role (ASM-091)
• device_id / center_id: App installation UUID & collection center ID
• latitude / longitude: GNSS fix coordinates for transporter custody acts
• weight_kg / drying_lot_id: Measured weight & drying lot identifier
• outcome / reason / receiver_reference: Status, rationale, port receipt ref
DynamoDB Stores (Application Tables; KMS Keys Covered by Box D06):
• sack_event_log: PK event_id | Immutable event log | KMS 'records' [Box D06] | Streams enabled
• sacks: PK sack_id | GSI sack_code, farm_id | Current state, version, flags | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• sack_history: PK sack_id, SK recorded_at#event_id | Deterministic fold source | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• trips: PK trip_id | Transporter custody legs & vehicles | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• transport_positions: PK trip_id, SK sequence_no | 5-min GNSS fixes | KMS 'telemetry' [Box D06] (PD-110)
• buyer_view: PK sack_code | Projected public view | KMS 'public_view' [Box D06] (ASM-154)
Disaster Recovery Objectives (Sec 9, ASM-157, PD-153):
• RPO = 15 min: sack-exporter streams JSON Lines to S3 export prefix (ADR-001) every 60 s;
CloudWatch alarm fires if iterator age > 5 min.
• RTO = 4 h: Public lookup runs serverless via CloudFront + Lambda URL + buyer_view;
completely decoupled from application API!
